**Inbox disposition** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`): reviewed for delegated ruling and **declined — this is the platform's call, and it is the SAME call as objectstack#7494.** Both cards are one contract question about the `view` namespace in `sys_metadata`: #7494 asks how personalization rows are SCOPED (org-wide today while the console promises personal), this card asks how they are CLASSIFIED (a personalization row keyed like a saved view masquerades as user-created and gains Rename/Delete/Set-default/Pin). Ruling either alone risks the two answers disagreeing about what a `view` row IS. A client-side patch here (e.g. filtering `listViews()` by a provenance marker) would presuppose a marker the platform hasn't defined — exactly the kind of consumer-side invention AGENTS.md #0.1 forbids.

Folded into the #7494 decision as consumer-side evidence #2 (cross-referenced there). `needs-user-decision` stays; restart condition = the objectstack ruling on the view-row contract, after which the objectui half (honor the scoping/classification in `listViews()` consumers and the tab affordance gates) becomes a scoped dispatch.

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Maintainer ruling recorded 2026-08-11 (PM session, executing the maintainer's direct instruction in chat — verbatim: 「接受你的全部建议，请更新 issue 的状态和标签」, accepting the four-lens decision-inbox review in full).

**Ruling (paired with objectstack#7494):** personalization rows must be distinguishable from saved views — write-side marker and/or read-side exclusion in `listViews()` — and a system view must never become deletable/renamable because an overlay row exists for it. Per objectstack#7494's ruling the overlay contract is explicitly **org-wide shared view settings** (a permission gate on the write lands platform-side under that card); console prose/UX stops presenting these as personal preferences. A true per-user scope is parked as a v18 direction on the platform side — do not build client-side workarounds for it.

State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (objectui whole-repo seat).

Scope per the maintainer's 2026-08-11 ruling (paired with objectstack#7494): personalization rows become distinguishable from saved views — write-side marker in `updateViewConfig` and/or read-side exclusion in `listViews()`, with legacy unmarked rows measured and handled — so a system view never becomes deletable/renamable because an override row exists; PR #4224's system-view control gains the companion fixture WITH an override row. Console/plugin prose stops presenting these as personal preferences (the ruled contract is org-wide shared view settings). ⛔ Not here: the write-side permission gate (platform card under objectstack#7494) and any per-user scope (parked v18, no client-side workarounds). PR will be `Fixes #4227`.
